---

### 1. Navigation Bar
* **Logo (Left):** "MORROW" set in a clean, all-caps serif typeface.
* **Links & Action (Right):**
  * Plain text links: **Menu**, **Visit**, **Catering**
  * Call-to-Action (CTA) button: A rounded, rust/terracotta-colored pill button labeled **"Get in touch"** with white text.

---

### 2. Hero Section
* **Layout:** A two-column split layout on a warm beige background.
* **Left Column (Text & CTA):**
  * **Headline:** *"Catering for offices"* (large, elegant serif font).
  * **Subheading:** *"Bread, pastries and coffee, brought to your meeting."* (neutral sans-serif body text).
  * **CTA Button:** A duplicate rounded pill button labeled **"Get in touch"**.
* **Right Column (Visual):**
  * A large photo with softly rounded corners displaying a catered breakfast/lunch spread on a wooden table: a large silver coffee urn, mugs with stirrers, trays filled with croissants, pain au chocolat, pastries, and wrapped sandwiches, with blurred figures in the background.

---

### 3. Points Section (Three Columns)
Set between subtle horizontal divider lines, this section outlines key ordering logistics in three columns:

1. **Order 24 hours ahead**
   * *Text:* "Give us a day's notice and we will have it ready."
2. **Minimum 10 people**
   * *Text:* "Catering starts at ten people."
3. **To arrange it**
   * *Text:* "Email hello@morrow.example or call 020 7946 0958."

---

### 4. Footer
A clean, single-line horizontal bar at the bottom:
* **Brand (Left):** "Morrow" (bold sans-serif).
* **Location & Hours (Center):** "41 Harbour Road, open 7am–4pm, closed Mondays"
* **Contact & Socials (Right):** "hello@morrow.example · 020 7946 0958 · Instagram @morrowcafe"

---

### 5. Layout and Readability Observations / Issues

* **Redundant CTA Buttons:** Having the "Get in touch" button both in the top navigation bar and directly underneath the hero subheading—only a short distance apart—feels repetitive and clutters the visual hierarchy.
* **No Active Navigation State:** The user is on the "Catering" page, but the "Catering" link in the header has no visual indicator (such as an underline, bolding, or color change) to show it is the active page.
* **Hero Vertical Alignment / Balance:** The text block on the left hero side occupies much less vertical height than the large photo on the right. Vertically centering the text block against the image or slightly expanding the copy would improve balance.
* **Low Contrast Dividers & Body Text:** The horizontal rules separating the sections are extremely faint and may not be visible on screens with lower contrast or brightness. The grey secondary body copy on the beige background may also fall short of strict WCAG AA accessibility contrast ratios.
